name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-07-11, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.61 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
